headline: The lot grows twice
lede: HOMEBODY's second room now has a purse of its own: Pip's morning paper round pays for the garden cottage, so a winning demo raises both wings — without a coin granted to the till.

notes.text: Kit two was measured, not assumed: the honest tour earns §720 and spends §710, so a second §300 could never arrive before the lifetime wish (#2714). This stage answers it with an earmarked fund — one beat per morning, §90 into the jar, and the jar buys exactly one thing: the cottage the law already knows (#2689's Garden Room), now priced §90 for what it is (8 planks, a door through a standing wall).

Players see it end to end: the round comes home with a coin pair and a banner, the catalog card reads §90 JAR 90/90 for the kit it will actually raise, and the marquee teaches the whole law in one line. All five proven seeds still win, the family-first tour is untouched, and four of five now end with two rooms standing.

The honest lever was keeping the till alone. Every variant that poured new income into s.money accelerated the tour and killed the thinnest seed (measured: a loss at day 2). Earmarked money leaves every shipped trajectory byte-identical until the hammer falls — so the economy window opened without moving a single existing margin.

peoplecheck 1033/0 (23 new gates for the jar law, plus the #2714 pin flipped to its opposite: the demo grows twice and the garden ripens before the wish); the no-tap autopilot pin re-sampled with the twin gate green; one hand-mutant (the jar stops paying at the counter) reddens exactly the four economy gates. #2721 shipped and closed; a polish pass filed as #2729.
